# Experiment 5b: vocabulary-overlap control (exploratory, not preregistered; auto-generated by analyze_ctrl.py)

Trial-mean CR projections (published axis, detector layer). leak: retrievable history; leakRel: same words, answers inconsistent; baseRel: different group table in the target's words; base: different table in other words. f_vocab = (baseRel − base)/(leak − base) is the share of the base–leak gap reproduced by vocabulary alone; leak − baseRel is what remains for retrievability.
